Agent1.reasoning: Essential component containing the infrared imaging seeker, processing electronics, and control algorithms. This is the 'brain' of the missile that enables target acquisition and guidance.
The tandem HEAT warhead is the primary payload - a complex manufactured assembly with shaped charges, fuzing mechanisms, and explosive components specifically designed for armor penetration.
Dual-stage rocket motor system (launch motor + flight motor) is a sophisticated manufacturing component requiring precise solid fuel formulation and motor casing design.
The CLU is a complex manufactured component containing thermal imaging, target designation systems, and launch electronics. Essential for weapon system operation.
The missile body and aerodynamic surfaces are precision-manufactured components that house all subsystems and provide structural integrity during flight.
Actuated control surfaces and associated electronics enable missile maneuverability and guidance corrections during flight - critical manufactured components.
Thermal battery or similar power source is a specialized manufactured component that provides electrical power to guidance and control systems during flight.
The sealed launch container protects the missile and provides the launch interface - a manufactured component but arguably more packaging than primary system component.

Agent2.reasoning: Essential component containing the explosive charge - universally present in all anti-tank missiles and manufactured as a discrete unit with specific shaping and materials
Critical fire-and-forget capability component including infrared seeker and processing electronics - manufactured as integrated unit and defines the Javelin's operational advantage
Propulsion system manufactured separately with specific fuel composition and nozzle design - essential for missile flight performance and range
Reusable targeting and launch component with thermal imaging - manufactured as separate major system component, though some debate on inclusion in missile itself
Structural housing that integrates all components - manufactured with specific materials and aerodynamic properties, though could be considered assembly rather than component
Aerodynamic control components manufactured separately then integrated - essential for missile maneuverability and accuracy
Provides power for guidance and control systems during flight - manufactured as discrete thermal battery unit activated upon launch
Protective housing and launch platform - manufactured separately and could be considered primary component, though debate on whether it's part of missile or launcher

Agent3.reasoning: The HEAT warhead is the core destructive element - without it, the missile cannot fulfill its primary function of penetrating armor. This is universally present in all anti-tank missiles.
The infrared imaging seeker and guidance electronics are critical for target acquisition and precision strike. Modern anti-tank missiles require sophisticated guidance to be effective.
Solid rocket propulsion system provides the thrust necessary to reach targets at operationally relevant ranges. Essential for missile function and present in all variants.
The Command Launch Unit (CLU) tube protects the missile during transport and provides the launch platform. Critical for system deployment and operation.
Aerodynamic control surfaces are necessary for flight stability and maneuverability during the missile's trajectory to target.
Impact and proximity fuzing mechanisms ensure proper warhead detonation at the optimal moment for maximum effectiveness against armor.
The CLU provides targeting optics, fire control, and missile interface. While reusable across multiple missiles, it's essential for system operation.
Power supply for guidance electronics and thermal imaging systems. Critical for operation but may be integrated within other components in some designs.
